name: ORKS: TRUKK
description:
Trukks are built primarily for speed, and usually have little in the way of armour plating. No two Trukks look the same, but they're typically covered with a mass of excessive pipework, sheet metal, afterburners, exhausts, and other exposed gubbinz. They are also fitted with rails and runners so Orks can hang onto any bit they can reach while they hurtle towards the front lines.

Get the Boyz to the Front

This multipart plastic kit builds a Trukk, a ramshackle transport for your Ork armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. This fast, lightly armoured vehicle is intended to get your Boyz to wherever the fighting is thickest so they can get stuck in. Equipped with a dual big shoota and an optional grabbin' klaw or buzzsaw, they can also join in the fun of battle. Every self-respecting Orks player will want one of these impressive miniatures in their collection to open up new tactical options for their army and look extra Orky in the process.

Kustomise Your Ride

This versatile kit gives you loads of options that can be mixed and matched to get a variety of different designs – ideal for anyone with more than one Trukk in their army.

– A heavy spiked ram or dozer blade can be added to the front
– Wheel axles can be tilted left, right, or kept level
– The shooting platform can be located on the vehicle's left or right
– The dual big shoota can be replaced with a rokkit launcha
– A Grot can be added hanging from the side
– A flag with a choice of 2 toppers can be added
– An optional grabbin' klaw or buzzsaw can be added
– Comes with a choice of 2 air intakes
– Each of the 3 Ork crew comes with a choice of 2 heads

Contents:
– 115 plastic components
– 1 construction guide
– 1 Orks Transfer Sheet

The Orks Transfer Sheet features 385 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include symbols and icons for the Goffs, Bad Moons, Snakebites, Evil Suns, Blood Axes, and Deathskulls, as well as universal Ork glyphs, symbols, and decorations.

This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
